Spot Bitcoin Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) are showing signs of caution with some outflows.

details: Ethereum (ETH) has shown some resilience, reclaiming $2,500 as short-term support, though it has seen a 0.44% decrease in the last 24 hours. Both cryptocurrencies are influenced by the broader market's risk-off sentiment.
